title: Design System: Ilias Ennajmi — Why people act, who profits

inkModeColorMeta.note: Ink mode is a full mirrored dark theme, toggled via data-theme on <html>, not a separate design language — same roles, same rules, inverted lightness.

display.purpose: Hero titles, page h1s, drop caps, blockquote text. Tight leading, slightly negative tracking.

body.purpose: Essay paragraph text. Generous 1.66 line-height is the system's single most load-bearing typographic decision.

label.purpose: All UI chrome — nav, buttons, eyebrows, metadata. Always uppercase, always wide-tracked, never full sentences.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for reveals, hairline draw-ins, and section transitions.

motion.name: ease-snap
motion.purpose: Sharper easing for the mobile drawer and other UI-chrome slides.

motion.name: ink-pour
motion.purpose: Signature theme-toggle transition: a flat disc of the incoming theme's background expands from the clicked button before the real theme flips underneath it.

motion.name: diamond-flash
motion.purpose: One-shot scale+rotate flash on the reading meter's diamond the instant an essay is finished.

components.name: Primary CTA (pill button)
components.description: Standalone call-to-action, e.g. 'See all Ulysses →'. Pill-shaped, border-only, no fill ever.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-block; font-family: 'Space Grotesk Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--oxblood, #a52716); border: 1px solid rgba(41,28,15,0.14); border-radius: 40px; padding: 14px 26px; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .3s, letter-spacing .3s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: var(--oxblood, #a52716); letter-spacing: 0.22em; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--oxblood, #a52716); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Icon Utility Button
components.description: Square utility button (theme toggle, search trigger) — sharp corners, hairline border, no fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: none; border: 1px solid rgba(41,28,15,0.14); color: #574738; width: 36px; min-height: 36px; padding: 0; font-size: 0.9rem; cursor: pointer; transition: color .25s, border-color .25s; } .ds-btn-icon:hover { color: #291c0f; border-color: #574738; } .ds-btn-icon:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a52716; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Borderless input sitting inside a bordered parent (command palette). Set in Display type so search feels like writing.
components.css: .ds-input-search { flex: 1; width: 100%; background: none; border: none; outline: none; font-family: 'Fraunces Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.2rem; color: #291c0f; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: #574738; opacity: 0.7; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Primary nav item — Label typography, Umber at rest, Ink + accent underline when active.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-family: 'Space Grotesk Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #574738; text-decoration: none; transition: color .25s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #291c0f; } .ds-nav-link--active { color: #291c0f; } .ds-nav-link--active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -6px; height: 1.5px; background: #a52716; }

components.name: List Item (search result / topic row)
components.description: Flex row with a leading diamond marker, 1px bottom border, background-shift on hover/active — the shared shape for command-palette results, topic rows, and shelf items.
components.html: Anchoring in the wildIlias · Pricing · 6 min
components.css: .ds-list-item { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px; padding: 13px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(41,28,15,0.14); text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s ease; } .ds-list-item:hover, .ds-list-item:focus-visible { background: rgba(41,28,15,0.14); } .ds-list-item-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; flex: none; margin-top: 7px; background: #a52716; transform: rotate(45deg); } .ds-list-item-body { min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-list-item-title { display: block; font-family: 'Fraunces Variable', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.3; color: #291c0f; } .ds-list-item-meta { display: block; font-family: 'Space Grotesk Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.6rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #574738; margin-top: 3px; }

components.name: Card (lead / featured)
components.description: Sharp-cornered container, hairline border, Paper Soft background shift as its only interactive feedback.
components.html: FeaturedStart here — a curated path through both strands
components.css: .ds-card { display: block; background: #e3dac9; border: 1px solid rgba(41,28,15,0.14); border-radius: 0; padding: clamp(24px, 3.5vw, 42px); text-decoration: none; transition: background .45s ease; } .ds-card-eyebrow { display: block; font-family: 'Space Grotesk Variable', sans-serif; font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #a52716; margin-bottom: 10px; } .ds-card-title { display: block; font-family: 'Fraunces Variable', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 2.5vw, 1.9rem); color: #291c0f; }

components.name: Diamond Marker
components.description: The system's one recurring decorative shape — a rotated square, reused as bullet, tick, active-dot, and section node across every page.
components.css: .ds-diamond { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; background: #a52716; transform: rotate(45deg); }

narrative.overview: A quiet, paper-and-ink space built for uninterrupted long-form reading — every decision defers to the words on the page rather than competing with them. The voice is unhurried and precise: pacing is editorial, never urgent, with nothing on the page performing for attention it hasn't earned. Two long-form strands (Ulysses for psychology, Ilias for marketing) are typographically identical twins distinguished only by a single accent-color swap (coffee brown vs. oxblood red), so the reading experience itself argues the site's whole thesis — these are the same mechanism, seen from two angles. Depth is conveyed only through tonal layering and hairline dividers, never shadows; color is almost entirely absent except for one recurring red, spent rarely and on purpose. The repeated diamond mark — a small square rotated 45°, standing in for bullets, ticks, active-state dots, and section nodes — is the system's one recurring shape, doing quietly everywhere what a logo would do loudly.
keyCharacteristics: Warm beige paper ground with near-black ink text — never true white/black
Exactly one accent hue family (oxblood/signal-red), spent sparingly
Flat surfaces throughout: zero box-shadows, depth via tone + hairline only
Sharp rectangular edges by default; pill and circle are the only rounded exceptions
One recurring diamond mark as the sole decorative motif
Fully mirrored dark ("ink") theme, toggled with a signature circular ink-pour transition

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Exactly one hue family (Oxblood/Signal Red) is allowed to carry emphasis or urgency anywhere in the system. Coffee is not a second accent — it exists solely to mark 'this is Ulysses content,' never as a general highlight color.

rules.name: The Vivid-Is-Rare Rule
rules.body: Signal Red is reserved for headline punctuation, drop caps, and pull-quote accents. The moment it would appear in body copy, a link, or any surface larger than a few square centimeters, use Oxblood instead — Signal Red's whole effect depends on staying rare.

rules.name: The Mono-Never-Reads Rule
rules.body: Space Grotesk appears only as short uppercase labels and UI chrome. It never sets a sentence of actual prose.

rules.name: The Paper Doesn't Float Rule
rules.body: Zero box-shadows exist anywhere in the system. Depth is conveyed entirely through tonal layering and 1px hairline dividers. A design that reaches for a shadow to separate two surfaces has reached for the wrong tool here.

rules.name: The Sharp-Except-Pills Rule
rules.body: Rectangular elements carry zero corner radius by default. Two deliberate exceptions: CTA buttons (40px pill) and small circular dots/nodes (50%). Nothing else rounds.

dos: Do treat the rotated-square diamond as the system's only decorative marker shape — reuse it rather than introducing a second icon/bullet motif.
Do keep Signal Red rare: headline punctuation, drop caps, pull-quote borders only.
Do set every label/eyebrow/nav/meta string in Label typography (mono, uppercase, wide-tracked) — never in Body or Display.
Do convey separation with a Paper Line hairline or a Paper→Paper Soft tone shift, never a shadow.
Do reserve the 40px pill radius for standalone CTA buttons only.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion on every animated component by rendering the end state instantly instead.
donts: Don't add a box-shadow anywhere; the system has none and depends on having none.
Don't introduce a second general-purpose accent color — Coffee is strand-scoped, not a spare accent.
Don't round a card, panel, image, or embed's corners — 0 radius is the default, not an oversight.
Don't set body prose in Space Grotesk, or a UI label in EB Garamond — the pairing's whole effect depends on that boundary staying crisp.
Don't embed a real third-party logo or brand mark, even as a placeholder.
